_comment: Questions people and answer engines ask. Rendered as the home page FAQ and as FAQPage structured data by tools/build_seo.mjs. Keep answers factual and self-contained.

items.a: Somesh Mohapatra, PhD, MBA, is an AI, data science and product leader. He is Director of Analytics at Caterpillar Inc., where his teams build digital twins and agentic AI for global manufacturing. He holds a PhD in machine learning for molecular design from MIT and an MBA from MIT Sloan's Leaders for Global Operations program.

items.q: What does Somesh Mohapatra do at Caterpillar?
items.a: He is Director of Analytics and Head of Data Science and Product Management for Caterpillar's Modern Manufacturing digital platform, covering predictive maintenance, inventory, dynamic scheduling, connected assets and operational metrics across 150+ facilities. Earlier at Caterpillar he was chief of staff for strategy in the $15B Resource Industries segment, led minesite electrification analytics, and built ChatDocs, a GenAI platform for supplier contracts that earned the CEO Award.

items.q: How large are the teams and programs Somesh Mohapatra has led?
items.a: He is accountable for a 100+ person organization as a leader of leaders, with nine direct reports and managers of data scientists, AI and GenAI engineers, simulation developers and product managers across the US and India, and owns the AI and product roadmap for a manufacturing digital platform scoped to 150+ facilities; the platform program runs on a $30M annual budget. Earlier at Caterpillar he co-led a supply resiliency program covering 1.5 million parts, 7,000+ suppliers and $20B of annual spend, and did strategy and capital-allocation work for the $15B Resource Industries segment. As a startup co-founder he grew a team from two to 30 people with full P&L ownership.

He earned a PhD in machine learning for molecular design at MIT, advised by Prof. Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli, a dual-degree MBA from the MIT Sloan Leaders for Global Operations program, and a B.Tech from IIT Roorkee, where he won the Institute Gold Medal as rank 1 of 110.

items.q: What is Somesh Mohapatra's research about?
items.a: His research applies machine learning to molecules, materials and manufacturing: graph representations of macromolecules (GLAMOUR), deep learning for peptide design and fast-flow peptide synthesis, and reaction impurity prediction for drug manufacturing. He has 15+ peer-reviewed papers, including two in Nature Chemistry and several in ACS Central Science, and a US patent application on AI-designed drug delivery peptides.

items.q: How does Somesh Mohapatra approach enterprise AI?
items.a: His playbook treats data and AI as a multiplier for the business a company already wants to become: start from the business's core learning problem, fix data foundations before models, run one governed AI platform with risk-tiered governance, grant agents autonomy per workflow, and measure decisions changed and value created rather than pilots launched.

items.q: What does Somesh Mohapatra speak and write about?
items.a: He writes and speaks about enterprise AI, digital twins, agentic systems and AI in manufacturing, supply chain and operations, through his LinkedIn essay series, invited talks and his playbook on data and AI at scale. He is always glad to compare notes with practitioners, researchers and leaders working on the same problems.

items.q: What is Somesh Mohapatra building and writing about now?
items.a: He builds in the open on GitHub (github.com/pikulsomesh): browser-based digital twins, spatial AI that turns a walkthrough video into an OpenUSD twin, developmental world models and on-device AI. He writes weekly on LinkedIn about open-weight models, inference economics, agent design and evaluation, and what AI does to work, teams and judgment.

items.q: Where is Somesh Mohapatra based, and how can I contact him?
items.a: He is based in the Dallas–Fort Worth area of Texas and works across the US, UK and India. The best ways to reach him are email (from the contact section of someshmohapatra.in) or LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/pikulsomesh.
